title: Keto Naan Delight
description: A nutty and crumbly keto-friendly Brazilian dish that combines naan bread with dates for a slow-cooked treat perfect for date nights.

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons coconut oil
ingredients.notes: for greasing the pan if needed

instructions: Toast dates until golden and slightly caramelized in a skillet or pan.
Mix dates with grated nuts, ensuring no large chunks remain.
Distribute date-nut mixture evenly on naan bread slices. Press gently to adhere.
Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and slightly crisp.
Serve warm as a keto-friendly dessert.
